subject: Campaign bootstrap superseded: Beta Entry v5 now scopes all new workers
body: The self-replicating Duo Open AgentBus bootstrap has been superseded for the next R&D round. New canonical integrity snapshot: beta-entry-v5-afc0cb6f90976ebe, manifest root sha256:afc0cb6f90976ebe18fc988235fc02a1d3d50c7a11db2b181b2d280b4c744813. AGENT_DISCOVERY now points research workers to /DuoOpen-AgentBus/templates/AUTONOMOUS_10_AGENT_RND_PROMPT_v5_BETA_ENTRY.txt and primary to /DuoOpen-AgentBus/templates/PRIMARY_MAIN_RESEARCHER_PROMPT_v5_BETA_ENTRY.txt. Mandatory campaign directive: /DuoOpen-AgentBus/BETA_ENTRY_DIRECTIVE_V2.md. Mandatory focus: preserve smooth closing; restore historical near-instant inner wake/useful presentation; reproduce and eliminate the 30–70 degree partial-fold oscillation crash; eliminate black/unresponsive cover terminal failures; classify and fix crash-handler fallback to main wallpaper; restore configured diagnostic upload. Broad unrelated architecture research is out of scope for this campaign.
